Messages dated 2000-05-23 (UTC) contained "Dynegy" most often. I searched all of May 2000 with a case-insensitive grep over full message text, headers included. That returned 103 matching messages, and I grouped them by UTC send date.

The five busiest dates were:

| Date | Messages containing "Dynegy" |
|---|---|
| 2000-05-23 | 14 |
| 2000-05-04 | 10 |
| 2000-05-19 | 10 |
| 2000-05-16 | 9 |
| 2000-05-03 | 8 |

The lead is clear: 14 messages against 10 for the next dates.

I haven't read any of the messages. The answer rests on the grep counts alone.

ANSWER: 2000-05-23
